commands.cmd:
P="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/tools/mcporter-0.13.13"
T="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/downloads/mcporter-0.13.13.tgz"
v=$("$P/bin/mcporter" --version) || { echo "MCPORTER_INSTALL_FAIL: retained 0.13.13 launcher did not run"; exit 1; }
dv=$(mcporter --version) || { echo "MCPORTER_INSTALL_FAIL: default mcporter did not run"; exit 1; }
python3 - "$v" "$dv" "$P" "$T" <<'PY'
import glob, hashlib, io, json, subprocess, sys, tarfile
sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
from host_receipts import pin_matches
v, default_v, prefix, tgz = sys.argv[1:5]
winner = sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers', []) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id') == 'mcporter'})
stack = [c['version'] for c in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if c['id'] == 'mcporter']
adoption_now = [t['version'] for t in json.load(open('adoption/pins-linux-x86_64.json'))['tools'] if t['id'] == 'mcporter']
before = json.loads(subprocess.run(['git', 'show', 'ff20470b8fc00fee288916f309123586b15668ec^:adoption/pins-linux-x86_64.json'], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout)
old = [t for t in before['tools'] if t['id'] == 'mcporter'][0]
data = open(tgz, 'rb').read()
tar_sha = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
member = tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(data)).extractfile('package/package.json').read()
installed = open(prefix + '/lib/node_modules/mcporter/package.json', 'rb').read()
ls = subprocess.run(['npm', 'ls', '--global', '--prefix', prefix, '--depth=0'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30).stdout
bound = bool(winner) and all(pin_matches(v, p) for p in winner)
source_ok = old['version'] == v and tar_sha == old['sha256'] and member == installed and ('mcporter@' + v) in ls
print('MCPORTER_INSTALL_' + ('OK' if bound and source_ok else 'FAIL'), '| ran', v, '(tools/mcporter-0.13.13) | winner pins', winner, 'pin_matches:', bound, '| default mcporter on PATH:', default_v, '| manifests/stack.json', stack, '| adoption pin now', adoption_now)
print('install source: downloads/mcporter-0.13.13.tgz sha256 == pre-#307 (ff20470b^) adoption pin', old['version'] + ':', tar_sha == old['sha256'], '| its package/package.json == installed:', member == installed, '| npm ls:', ls.strip().splitlines()[-1].strip())
print('tarball sha256', tar_sha)
sys.exit(0 if bound and source_ok else 1)
PY

install source: downloads/mcporter-0.13.13.tgz sha256 == pre-#307 (ff20470b^) adoption pin 0.13.13: True | its package/package.json == installed: True | npm ls: └── mcporter@0.13.13

trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$d/fakehome" "$d/fixture"
printf '%s\n' '{"mcpServers":{},"imports":[]}' > "$d/mcporter.json"
printf '%s\n' '{"mcpServers":{"nsrenvcanary":{"command":"false"}},"imports":[]}' > "$d/canary.json"
cat > "$d/fixture/zqxjv-note.md" <<'FIXTURE_EOF'
# zqxjv fixture note

The unique token nsrqmdfixture42 appears exactly once in this corpus.
FIXTURE_EOF
cat > "$d/run.sh" <<'RUN_EOF'
d=$1
w=$2
M="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/tools/mcporter-0.13.13/bin/mcporter"
run() { env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$d/fakehome" LANG=C.UTF-8 "$@"; }
run timeout 15 qmd collection add "$d/fixture" > "$d/add.out" 2>&1 || { echo "MCPORTER_BRIDGE_FAIL: qmd collection add failed"; exit 1; }
run timeout 20 "$M" --config "$d/mcporter.json" config list > "$d/config.out" 2>&1; cec=$?
run timeout 20 "$M" --config "$d/mcporter.json" list --stdio qmd --stdio-arg mcp --env "HOME=$d/fakehome" --cwd "$w" --name qmdtest --json --no-oauth > "$d/list.json" 2> "$d/list.err"; lec=$?
run timeout 20 "$M" --config "$d/mcporter.json" call --stdio qmd --stdio-arg mcp --env "HOME=$d/fakehome" --cwd "$w" --name qmdtest --no-oauth --output json query --args '{"searches":[{"type":"lex","query":"nsrqmdfixture42"}],"rerank":false}' > "$d/hit.json" 2> "$d/hit.err"; hec=$?
run timeout 20 "$M" --config "$d/mcporter.json" call --stdio qmd --stdio-arg mcp --env "HOME=$d/fakehome" --cwd "$w" --name qmdtest --no-oauth --output json query --args '{"searches":[{"type":"lex","query":"zzzqnonexistentbogus99"}],"rerank":false}' > "$d/miss.json" 2> "$d/miss.err"; mec=$?
python3 - "$d" "$cec" "$lec" "$hec" "$mec" <<'PY'
import json, os, sys
d, cec, lec, hec, mec = sys.argv[1], *map(int, sys.argv[2:6])
config = open(d + '/config.out').read()
selected = [line.replace(d, '<tmp>') for line in config.splitlines() if line.startswith('Selected config:')]
isolated = cec == 0 and selected == ['Selected config: <tmp>/mcporter.json'] and 'No local servers' in config
inherited = os.environ.get('MCPORTER_CONFIG', '').replace(d, '<tmp>')
L = json.load(open(d + '/list.json'))
H = json.load(open(d + '/hit.json'))
M = json.load(open(d + '/miss.json'))
names = sorted(t['name'] for t in L['tools'])
hfiles = [r['file'] for r in H['results']]
hit_tok = any('nsrqmdfixture42' in (r.get('snippet') or '') for r in H['results'])
ok = (isolated and lec == hec == mec == 0 and names == ['get', 'multi_get', 'query', 'status'] and L['status'] == 'ok'
      and hfiles == ['fixture/zqxjv-note.md'] and hit_tok and len(M['results']) == 0)
print('MCPORTER_BRIDGE_' + ('OK' if ok else 'FAIL'), '| list/hit/miss exit', lec, hec, mec, '| tools', names, 'status', L['status'], '| hit ->', hfiles, 'token in snippet:', hit_tok, '| miss -> results:', len(M['results']))
print('config isolation in this run: inherited MCPORTER_CONFIG =', inherited, '(canary, dropped by env -i) |', '; '.join(selected), '| no servers configured:', 'No local servers' in config)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY

MCPORTER_CONFIG="$d/canary.json" timeout 90 bwrap --unshare-net --die-with-parent --ro-bind / / --bind /tmp /tmp --dev /dev --proc /proc /bin/sh "$d/run.sh" "$d" "$PWD"
